Being a CSE graduate from North South University gave me a problem-solving mindset that naturally blends with design. I approach creative work with both logic and aesthetics — focusing on clarity, functionality, and meaningful brand experiences.

I love turning ideas into brands that move people. What started as freelance creative work grew into a career when I joined Commercial Bank of Ceylon — where I now lead in-house design across campaigns, branches, and identity systems.

I focus on creating brand work that does a job – not just looks pretty. Whether I'm crafting an Islamic Banking logo, building a brand manual, or coordinating an event activation, the goal is communication that's clear, on-brand, and effective.

I'm a bit of a perfectionist when it comes to the details, but I think that's what separates good branding from forgettable branding. The same care goes into a corporate presentation, a campaign poster, or an internal memo — it's all the brand.
